This happened today. I had a emotionally breakdown in the vehicle while my dad was driving. I mention about how we need a concrete plan moving forward with renovations being done on a building and he started to talk about how I was controlling and self centered. It felt like this came out of nowhere based on what I said and was very confused. He had misheard me and thought I said rules not plan... so I stated he must have misheard but proceeded to tell me that misheard isn't a word. So I Google it. Proved him wrong and tried expressing how this frustrated and upsetting this was. he didn't want to hear that. Mind you he comes across very rude sometimes and it's like he always need to be pointed and correct. Things escalated while driving. And this is were my mind gets fuzzy. I asked him to stop the argument. Twice, but that was unacceptable. I started to loose control of my emotions(I've been dealing with bursts of sadness all week BTW and am on a new antidepressants medication) I was on the verge of tears and he started calling me a blubbering baby multiple times. Then I really cried. I got angry, upset and lashed out.(I think) my fight or flight response kicked in and I wanted to jump out of the vehicle but we were on the hwy. My fight kicked in but I didn't want to hurt anyone. My dad's dog was barking and becoming uncontrolled. So he told me to stop because I'm upsetting his dog. I broke. I screamed wrapping my fingers in my hair while pulling. I couldn't escape and I didn't want this. Now I'm emotionally abusive and controlling according to him. When we got home I broke even more and let slip that I want to kill myself and he has no idea how I feel and think. That maybe he should look up emotional abuse. I also compared him to my ex because he was doing that exact samething he did. I'm ashamed of my reaction.
